question: Where is the largest football stadium in India located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kolkata** is home to the largest football stadium in India, known as the Salt Lake Stadium or officially the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan.
 
• The stadium has a seating capacity of around **85,000 spectators** after renovations, making it one of the largest football stadiums in the world.
 
• It was inaugurated in **1984** and has since hosted numerous national and international football matches, including the FIFA U-17 World Cup in 2017.
 
• The stadium is a multi-purpose venue but is primarily used for football matches and athletic events.
 
• It is the home ground for prominent football clubs like ATK Mohun Bagan and East Bengal FC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Salt Lake Stadium was the largest football stadium in the world before its capacity was reduced from over 120,000 to 85,000 for safety and comfort reasons.
 
• The stadium has also hosted other events like concerts and political rallies.
 
• It is named after Swami Vivekananda, a key figure in the introduction of Indian philosophies of Vedanta and Yoga to the Western world.
 
• The stadium complex includes facilities for various other sports like athletics, swimming, and volleyball.
 
• It has been a crucial venue for promoting and developing football in India, contributing significantly to the sport's growth in the region.
